title: TouchstoneQuote
description: The touchstone-quote extension riding inside an x402/MPP payment-required response — build1-spec.md §8.

decimalString.description: A decimal number encoded as a string. Never a JSON number — no floats in money maths.

settlementEntry.description: One accepted settlement method, x402-style. Build 1 permits exactly one entry and it must be USDC — enforced by the quote validator, not this schema, so wSIU/SIUSD can be added as further entries in build 2 with no format change.

address.description: The settlement asset's contract address on `chain`.

amount_max.description: Integer minor units as a string (e.g. USDC has 6 decimals) — drops straight into TouchstoneEscrow.openAndFund's uint256 maxAmount with no conversion at the contract boundary.

schema_version.description: Build 1 emits "1.0". A same-major bump is additive and safe for an existing consumer to accept; a major bump is not.

expiry.description: RFC3339 UTC, seller-set. A payer MUST reject an expired quote.

settler.description: Optional. An address the buyer additionally authorises to call TouchstoneEscrow.settle for this quote. Absent means seller-only settlement. Added in schema_version 1.1. The seller MUST verify this against the on-chain settler before performing work — see docs/datum-quote.md.

settlement.description: Accepted settlement methods, ordered by seller preference — mirrors x402's accepted-payment-methods structure rather than inventing a new shape.
